run_f_gold: run f_gold to count binary strings of length n with k adjacent two-set-bit occurrences
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the provided parameter sets in the main block
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold dynamic programming function that counts binary strings with k adjacent set bit pairs
review_f_gold: review the f_gold DP table transitions for counting adjacent two-set-bit patterns in binary strings
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to reduce the 3D DP table to a 2D space-optimized version
